title: A Postknight Mod
description: A mod to add Postknight content to Minecraft, a little bit at a time.
body:
A Postknight Mod is a simple mod aiming to add content from the Postknight games to Minecraft, a little at a time.

**Please note that it is not advised to play the mod in survival until at least 0.1.0 - the first beta.**

<details>
<summary>Roadmap</summary>
  
  0.0.1 - Alpha 1 - Metals (Bronze, Silver, Platinum, Dragonite) - Complete
  
  0.0.2 - Alpha 2 - Trees (Walnut, Maple, Frozen Fir, Cypress, Coral) - Complete
  
  ~~0.0.3 - Alpha 3 - Herbs, flowers, gems, and metals & woods specific to Postknight 1 (Too many to list)~~

  *This version has been split up into more manageable sub-alphas to create a more reasonable workload.*

  0.0.3a - Alpha 3a - Herbs (Postknight 2)

  0.0.3b - Alpha 3b - Herbs (Postknight 1)

  0.0.3c - Alpha 3c - Wood & metal from Postknight 1 missing from Alphas 1 & 2

  0.0.3d - Alpha 3d - Flowers (Both games)

  0.0.3e - Alpha 3e - Gems (Both games)

  0.0.3f - Alpha 3f - Optional resource pack to switch textures to Postknight 1 style where there is a discrepancy in appearances (main mod will be using Postknight 2 with priority)
  
  0.0.4 - Alpha 4 - Enemy drops (Maille)
  
  0.0.5 - Alpha 5 - Weapons & armour (Maille)
  
  0.0.6 - Alpha 6 - Potions (hopefully)
  
  0.1.0 - Beta 1 - Dire wolves (all 3 stages)
  
  0.2.0 - Beta 2 - Flowerflies & Blooplets
  
  0.3.0 - Beta 3 - Robblins (all 3)
  
  1.0.0 - Release 1 - All remaining Maille content
  
  2.0.0 - Release 2 - Pompon content
  
  3.0.0 - Release 3 - Caldemount content
  
  4.0.0 - Release 4 - Violetfair content
  
  5.0.0 - Release 5 - Aldor content
  
  ***Please note that this roadmap is subject to change without warning.***
</details>

When weapons are added (in 0.0.5), it will be advised to use this mod with the [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/project/5sy6g3kz) mod - inbuilt support will be included - to match the feel of the weapons. Epic fight will not be innately compatible.

*Bear in mind that this mod contains modified versions of Minecraft assets. I do not claim to have made the originals, and nor do I have any rights to them.*
